$comment: LITE ruleset — no PR requirement. Applied by github-config.sh to direct-to-master repos (public, not in pr-required-repos.json, no collaborators). A normal fast-forward push to master violates no rule, so there is NO bypass warning — clean direct pushes. Still blocks force-push, branch deletion, and non-linear history for everyone non-admin. Same name as the full ruleset so switching a repo full<->lite updates it in place. GitHub strips $comment on apply.
name: protect-default-branch
